players.product: 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers (incl. 800G LPO) on in-house silicon photonics chips; 3.2T / 6.4T NPO engines in customer testing

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Ma Xinqiang (Hubei listed companies' collective 2025 results briefing): orders on hand for domestic compute-center optical modules have grown significantly from last year, covering leading domestic internet companies and equipment makers, with 800G and 1.6T modules in volume delivery and a leading market share (company claim); demand in both the domestic and overseas markets is growing explosively this year and next. Director, VP and board secretary Liu Hanshu said the upstream material shortage stems from the surge in global AI demand and that delivery rates will improve as materials arrive in batches.

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Ma Xinqiang (collective 2025 results briefing): the company has built silicon-photonics PIC, VCSEL and CW laser capacity in advance and initiated the founding of upstream optical-chip maker Yunling Optoelectronics as its strategic upstream position, and its optical-chip supply can meet current orders and future growth. On glass bridges he said that once mature they would simplify module and light-engine design; the company is researching CPO, 2.5D and 3D packaging, with glass-substrate solutions one important technology path. Board secretary Liu Hanshu said the company released a 100G satellite-borne optical module in April 2026 and has completed customer sampling and joint testing of several low-earth-orbit satellite and 6G base-station modules.

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other businesses, chairman Ma Xinqiang (collective 2025 results briefing): its laser weeding equipment has completed testing in both southern and northern China and will be applied at scale this year; it has developed green-light 3D printing equipment and is working with server cooling-system makers (not named) on technical cooperation, development and testing of heat-dissipation parts; in embodied AI it has completed flexible-film technology and a production line usable for dexterous-hand skin sensors and battery and motor thermal management; in sensing it launched an integrated thermal-management module, flexible heating film and a fifth-generation WPTC heater and is building MEMS gas and pressure sensors.

players.product: 12-inch high-end wafer laser processing equipment (in a leading memory-wafer mass-production line)

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor equipment (collective 2025 results briefing): board secretary Liu Hanshu said the company's TGV (through-glass via) laser processing equipment has completed final design, with core components (laser, galvanometer, control system) 100% domestically made, and has completed initial pilot verification. Chairman Ma Xinqiang said that for third-generation compound semiconductors it has developed 10 tools covering front- and back-end processes through in-house R&D and industry-chain cooperation (wafer surface dicing, stealth dicing, wafer modification, fully automatic wafer annealing, substrate and epitaxy metrology), and that its PCB laser drilling automation focuses on high-end laser drilling for IC substrates, in cooperation with industry customers on applications.
quarterly_data.figure: TGV core components 100% domestic; 10 compound-semiconductor tools
